$description: Scrim editor chrome design system, resolved for transfer to an egui theme. Source of truth: apps/studio/src/theme.css (:root blocks) and apps/studio/src/appearance/derive.ts. Every colour is a concrete sRGB value; the original CSS is in $extensions.scrim.css. Chrome only: none of this ever styles a design node.

scrim.resolvedWith: theme.css loaded into headless Chrome 155.0.8059.80 (playwright-core) with html[data-theme=dark|light]; custom properties read with getComputedStyle; color-mix() and rgb(var() / a) resolved by assigning them to a probe element's color. Alpha-composited values (opacity, globalAlpha) and filter: brightness() are computed in sRGB by hand.
scrim.colorFormat: $value is #rrggbb, or #rrggbbaa when translucent (straight, unpremultiplied alpha). $extensions.scrim.rgba repeats translucent ones as rgba().
scrim.dimensionFormat: DTCG 2025 dimension objects: {value, unit}. 1 px = 1 logical point (egui points).
scrim.defaultTheme: dark (also the fallback before a theme resolves); the preference is system | light | dark, system by default
scrim.accentNote: accent.* and agent.* colours below are the DEFAULTS (orange #ff5a1f, violet #8e7bff) already derived; any other base colour must be run through accentRule.

accentRule.$description: How the accent (and agent) tokens are derived from ONE base colour per role. A port must reimplement derive.ts; the presets below are precomputed.

roleTokens.mark: icons, selected edges, focus ring, canvas selection, coloured text
roleTokens.fill: primary buttons, checked boxes, canvas chips

steps: Parse #rgb / #rrggbb; anything else is refused ("Use a hex colour such as #ff5a1f.").
Convert to HSL. Refuse when saturation < 0.18 or lightness > 0.97 or < 0.03 (reads as grey).

MARK, per theme: must reach 4.5:1 on panel, field, raised and float, and 3:1 on canvas and selected. If the base fails, move LIGHTNESS only (hue and saturation kept) in steps of 0.005, up to 200 steps: lighter on dark, darker on light. First passing value wins; none passes means refused.

FILL, per theme: the base itself if some label (#ffffff or #111214) reaches 4.5:1 on it AND the fill is 3:1 against the panel; else the nearest lighter HSL step that passes, else the nearest darker one.
ON-FILL: whichever of #ffffff and #111214 has the higher ratio on the fill (ties go to white); it must be >= 4.5.
TINT: the MARK rgb at alpha 0.16 (dark) / 0.12 (light).
The agent colour is refused when it is "too close" to the accent: hue distance < 20 degrees AND lightness difference < 0.2 (and vice versa).

Reported adjustment: "Lightened" / "Darkened" when the mark moved, "fill adjusted" when the fill moved; the light theme only reports when the dark theme moved too, or the light mark moved more than 0.3 in lightness.

the ONE shadow: floating surfaces only

scrim.rule: Docked panels are flat, separated by 1 px hairlines; no shadow, gradient, glow or blur anywhere in the chrome.

ring.$description: One focus ring for every keyboard-focused control (:focus-visible): 2 px accent outline, 1 px outside. Mouse focus on a field shows only the hover border. A field draws the ring on its wrapper, not the bare input. Never removed without a replacement.

scrim.css: :focus-visible { outline: var(--scrim-ring) solid var(--scrim-accent-mark); outline-offset: var(--scrim-ring-offset) }

duration.$description: the one duration: hover, press, colour, border, panel collapse, popover open, caret fade

scrim.reducedMotion: 0ms (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce sets every chrome transition and animation to 0)

rules: No animation on canvas content (the design world is inert).
No infinite animations in chrome: a running agent is a static dot and a word.

exceptions.revealFlash: scrim-reveal 1.6s ease-out (2 px accent ring fading out, controls a link points at)

canvasDisabledHandles.$description: handles when the group cannot resize

zIndex.$description: Chrome stacking order (DOM z-index). Design content never takes part.

lintPanel.$description: floating lint panel; canvas hint row; dock layers

popover.$description: menus, font / snap popovers, arrange tooltip

modal.$description: dialog scrim, command palette scrim, modifier pill
